in_english.name: Shandy
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shandy is believed to have originated as a nickname for someone who was fond of alcoholic beverages, particularly shandy, a drink made by mixing beer with lemonade. However, it can also be used to describe someone who is cheerful, light-hearted, or humorous.

While the meaning of the name no longer holds such a literal significance, its cultural heritage of relaxation and enjoyment still underpins it.
